A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SGV study. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–G are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original verifier evaluations, downstream agent experiments, robotic simulations, and extensive ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including digital-agent verification, online supervision, Reflexion, and robomimic experiments.

M1.justification: The operational two-step SGV procedure and appendix prompts remain unchanged. Section 3.2 broadens its formal description, but explicitly leaves repeated application to intermediate trajectories or subtasks for future work.

E1.justification: Both versions retain VisualWebArena, OSWorld, robomimic tool-hang, and AgentRewardBench coverage. Table 23's replacement of 'Eval Set' with 'VisualWebArena-Lite' names the subset already documented and evaluated in v2.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods, including CoT, SoM, majority voting and Pan et al. in Table 2; Search Agent and R-MCTS in Table 4; and WebJudge in Table 10. Reference removals do not remove evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The evaluation protocols remain unchanged, including label-to-reward mapping, calibration splits, model configurations, trajectory budgets, and outcome-based versus periodic verification schedules (Section 3.3; Appendices A, E, and F).

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same calibration, trajectory-length, agent-strength, prior-diversity, noisy-prior, grounding-tool, and verification-frequency analyses. The qualitative success and failure cases in Appendices C and G are also retained.

E5.justification: Reporting practices are unchanged: three-run digital results, 50 robotic rollouts, eight-completion sampling, and the bootstrap-estimated calibration threshold are already documented in v2. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and illustrated findings match across the versions, including Tables 1–24. For example, Table 4 retains base-agent/SGV success rates of 45%/54% on VisualWebArena and 22%/27% on OSWorld.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 generalizes the formal prior-conditioning input from states s_0:t used to frame the task to partial trajectories τ_u:v, indexing the prior accordingly. This is a limited expansion of the definition; the metric formulas remain unchanged and no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract qualifies the description of priors as 'independent of the data under evaluation' to conditioning on partial information, aligning it with the existing prompts. The central agreement-bias diagnosis, performance claims, and benchmark contributions remain intact.

C2.justification: Section 3.2 newly distinguishes the demonstrated initial-screenshot conditioning from possible repeated or subtask-based applications left for future work. Section 5 also qualifies the claim that verification trade-offs make post-hoc metrics insufficient. Existing perception and leniency–strictness limitations remain.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware, substantive prompt instructions, environment refinements, and project-access information are retained. The initial-screenshot/task input clarified in v3's main text was already explicitly documented in v2's Appendix B.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Zhang et al. (2023), Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Language Models, and expands the connection to environment-interaction reasoning. Brown et al.'s Large Language Monkeys and Zhang et al.'s ReST-MCTS* references are removed. Overall research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: Edits concentrate on the abstract, contribution bullets, and SGV explanation, with terminology and grammar refinements elsewhere. 'Self-refinement' becomes 'self-improvement' in prominent passages, and the header changes to ICLR 2026 publication status. Section organization and most appendix text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2's caption is relabeled 'Self-Improvement'; Table 23 gains a clearer caption and subset label, widening its layout. Several appendix screenshots are resampled and JPEG-encoded while retaining their content. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 improves precision by correcting the abstract's independence wording and distinguishing SGV's demonstrated conditioning from untested extensions in Section 3.2. Clearer contribution summaries and Table 23 labeling also aid interpretation. These are limited improvements in exposition and scope definition; empirical support and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
